title: Levels button
description: A soft-cornered (8px) button with a semibold label in the primary fill: ink on light grounds, white inside the dark bands, in three heights; optional trailing arrow that nudges right on hover. The fill fades to 90% over 150ms on hover.
notes: inside an element with the .dark class (the site's dark bands) it turns white with ink text
name: levels-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 36px (header) · md: 44–48px (panels, plan cards) · lg: 52px (hero, closing band)

props.name: arrow
props.description: add a small arrow after the label that nudges right on hover

props.name: block
props.description: stretch to the full width of the parent

props.name: type
props.description: button type when it renders a button
